Overview

Tractian combines an intuitive CMMS platform with proprietary plug-and-play IoT sensors to deliver predictive maintenance. It uses AI to analyze machine vibration and temperature, automatically generating work orders before failures occur.

Best For: Industrial plants looking for an all-in-one CMMS and predictive IoT sensor solution

Core Capabilities

Smart Trac IoT Sensors

Plug-and-play sensors that monitor 3-axis vibration and temperature, sending real-time data to the cloud.

AI-Driven Fault Detection

Proprietary machine learning models that identify specific mechanical failures (e.g., unbalance, misalignment) before they cause downtime.

Pros

  • Seamless integration of CMMS software and predictive IoT hardware
  • Highly accurate AI fault detection
  • Modern, user-friendly mobile and web interfaces

Cons

  • Pricing is custom and can be higher due to hardware inclusion
  • Vendor management features are less mature than legacy EAMs
